zalrpakraft.journal.p1:
Hello.

I don't know who you are or how you got here. I also just opened my eyes on this grass once.

So I left you something.
zalrpakraft.journal.p2:
My house is not far from here.

X: %1$s
Z: %3$s

(height about %2$s)

The door is not locked.
zalrpakraft.journal.p3:
Inside there is a table. I didn't build it.

Touch it and you will see the sky. Not this sky — another one.
zalrpakraft.journal.p4:
Meteors are not rocks. They are them — the ones waiting in the deep, in ice, in fire.

From what remains you can make keys. And eyes. Twelve of them.
zalrpakraft.journal.p5:
I almost made it to the end.

If you are reading this, the rest of the way is yours.

Don't go alone.

— N.
